mainEntity.name: Can I combine a facial and Head Spa?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The Matrix Head Spa + Hydrating Glow Facial combines scalp care with a mini facial and facial massage. The current menu also includes men's scalp-and-facial combinations. Check the booking menu for the experience and appointment length you prefer.

mainEntity.name: Do you offer lash fills as well as full sets?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Classic, Hybrid, and Volume lash extensions each have full-set and one-, two-, and three-week fill appointments. Choose the matching style and timing in the current booking menu.

mainEntity.name: Is hair drying included with Head Spa?

acceptedAnswer.text: Head Spa services leave hair wet. Luxury Blowout Styling is a separate add-on appointment with a cosmetologist, when available. Reserve it with your visit if you would like your hair professionally dried and styled.

mainEntity.name: Where do I go, and how do I book?

acceptedAnswer.text: Visit Matrix Massage & Bodywork at 24804 75th St, Salem, WI 53168. Book online through our current Square menu or text 262-939-9325. Our Salem studio welcomes guests from Salem Lakes, Paddock Lake, Bristol, Twin Lakes, Kenosha, and nearby Antioch, Illinois.
